title: Returned after attempting to mount to the wall
text: Returned after attempting to mount to the wall. It was very clearly not going to be stable against the wall with the enclosed hardware.  The bottom that you are supposed to press against was very wobbly.  There was nothing holding the bottom against the wall.  It was just hanging out. I packed it right back up and returned it.
